summary: This week brought a fresh batch of Pentagon UAP files into public view, with the latest document drop centering on "black triangle" sightings over military installations and a resurfaced Roswell account appearing in the seventh file release. Witnesses reported low-flying triangular craft near defense sites, while experts connected these incidents to a longer historical pattern of similar sightings. On the political front, Democrats outlined potential UAP investigation priorities if they regain majority control, and former Trump officials suggested the White House may be moving disclosure work outside traditional channels. A scientist proposed new sensor technology as a potential solution for identifying UAPs, while a former government researcher released a book detailing alleged encounters with non-human entities. Separately, recently declassified correspondence from The Black Vault showed decades of CIA FOIA disputes over UFO investigations, underlining how long this transparency battle has been underway.
